prompt: The chart below shows the average number of hours per week spent on four leisure activities by people of different age groups in one country in 2023.
tip: Bar chart (zaman yok): karşılaştırma dili kullan (the most, twice as much as, whereas). Gruplama önerisi: yaşla **artan** aktiviteler (TV, okuma) ve **azalanlar** (sosyal medya, spor).

chart.title: Average hours per week spent on leisure activities, by age (2023)

model:
The bar chart illustrates how many hours a week people in four age groups spent on social media, television, reading and sport in one country in 2023.
Overall, there was a clear contrast between the activities. Time spent on social media and sport fell as age increased, whereas watching television and reading became more popular among older people. Social media was the most common pastime for the youngest group, while television dominated for everyone over 45.
The 16–24 age group devoted 14 hours a week to social media, more than twice the time they spent watching TV (6 hours). This figure fell steadily with age, to just 2 hours among the over-65s. Sport followed a similar but much less pronounced pattern, declining gradually from 5 hours to 2.
Television viewing showed the opposite trend, tripling from 6 hours among the youngest respondents to 18 hours among those aged 65 and over, which was the highest figure in the chart. Reading also rose with age, although it remained the least popular activity for all groups except the oldest, where it reached 6 hours a week.
modelNotes: Overview iki zıt eğilimi aynı cümlede veriyor (whereas).
Karşılaştırma ifadeleri: more than twice, the opposite trend, tripling, the least popular.
Her sayıyı değil, uç değerleri ve dikkat çekici farkları seçiyor.
